source: Reuses unchanged withQaSession/serviceCredential. The dedicated QA account already exists; no founder issuer, account creation, privilege escalation or new profile editor.

One request-derived media nonce, original save nonce and original discard nonce. Exact synthetic 73-byte PNG, one-pixel image, body, alt description, nullable locality/listing and empty topics are guarded.

Request-only public main single-parent first-attempt push, 30-minute lifetime, exact code/deployed-web/Edge bundle hashes, immutable GitHub actions and one-hour cleanup grace. Disabled request performs no credential/network action.

Only the exact initial public feed request receives an explicitly controlled empty response. Discovery/provider reads are blocked. Actual admitted private Auth, draft/grant/Edge/Storage/cleanup responses are never replaced.
Original UI Save uploads and then attaches within the same action. Separate Edge internal grant/proof effects are not presented as additional UI controls.

Current phase-B byte-required function bodies and original canonical private RPC bodies are gated before run. Expected private RPC MD5s are derived from the accepted migration source; this author did not query actual live metadata.

Actual admitted onSaved read must confirm exact known media bytes/metadata/proof, private draft count, no public post, and a live grant bound to the current dedicated session ID with a 15-minute default lifetime (one-second timestamp-expression tolerance).

Authenticated private preview bytes are SHA-checked before original unchanged response reaches the UI. Original local PNG is removed before page reload; actual Reopen must recover exact text/alt/image through the existing canonical clients.

Cleanup checks/cancels original save receipt, reads current exact record/version and uses only original discard nonce; byte deletion waits for no active draft hold. Changed payload/version/owner authority or unknown receipt refuses destructive cleanup. Canonical request/version/grant/proof history is retained.

Always-cleanup cannot overwrite the original run success/failure. Failure emits fixed allowlisted stage/check and synthetic IDs only. A late unobserved Edge reservation after a failed upload remains uncertain and requires root reconciliation of original namespace; no failed browser run becomes acceptance.

Cleanup-only purpose does not open a browser, upload, save, publish, react, edit profiles/contacts, send or schedule. Object absence is checked with memory-only privileged read after exact canonical Edge discard. Session logout confirmation precedes evidence.
